title: ID0423045-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P9 170000980] Control panel-No signs of external damage
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: The fault was noticed by security on dn. 30.04.2025 at 9 p.m. This information was communicated to us by email on Monday 05.05.2025.On the same day in the afternoon an on-site inspection was carried out, as part of which photo documentation was collected - attached. The screen bears no signs of external damage (impact / collision). It has numerous cracks covering almost the entire surface of the glass sheet, and damage / chipping on the edges - similar to what happened a few months earlier.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0423045-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / P9 170000980]No signs of external damage CRM:02681000150
additional_info.body:
Hi,
comment from RC-PL.
We replaced the screen about 9 months ago. Everything according to the instructions, with the required tightening torque.
The screen most likely damaged itself after the installation period, this is the second such case at this location. I will get a video of the moment or period of the screen breakage in the near future.
Please give me a broad analysis of the topic, do we have an HMI problem here? Maybe it is an issue with this location? Temperatures in the recent period? Maybe we made an installation error?
The customer in the first case paid from insurance, but now the case is starting to look alarming unless it is confirmed that there was no act of vandalism.
Z wyrazami szacunku
Zespół Smart Infrastructure
Best regards
Smart Infrastructures Team
eMobility - Poland
